title: Sharpen your cybersecurity skills from home with this $21 bundle — only through today
content_html:
TL;DR: Through today, Aug. 2, get the 2026 AI Security & Cybersecurity Expert Bundle for $20.99 (reg. $120).

Credit: Oak Academy

$20.99
$120 Save $99.01

Artificial intelligence is changing the cybersecurity landscape from both sides. Businesses are adopting AI to improve productivity, while attackers are increasingly using it to automate phishing campaigns, reconnaissance, and other threats. That means security professionals — and anyone hoping to become one — need to understand both cybersecurity fundamentals and how AI fits into the picture.

The 2026 AI Security & Cybersecurity Expert Bundle is available for $20.99 through today, Aug. 2. This training package includes six courses and 88 hours of instruction covering practical skills for today’s evolving security environment.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

The bundle is designed for aspiring cybersecurity professionals, IT workers looking to expand their expertise, and experienced practitioners who want to better understand AI-powered security tools and threats. Alongside AI safety and secure workplace practices, you’ll study topics like ethical hacking, penetration testing with Metasploit, AI-assisted penetration testing, social engineering, and preparation for CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) and CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-003) concepts.

Highlights include:

  • 88 hours of self-paced training across six courses.

  • AI security for work and everyday use.

  • Ethical hacking and penetration testing techniques.

  • CompTIA Security+ and CySA+ exam-focused instruction.

  • Social engineering awareness using AI tools and GoPhish.

  • Practical skills you can build at your own pace.

Whether you’re working toward a cybersecurity career, strengthening your resume, or simply keeping your skills current as AI transforms the industry, this bundle offers a broad introduction to many of today’s most relevant security topics all in one place.
